entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Morning haze surrounded the city of..."
entries.dialogueText: Morning haze surrounded the city of Deyr as the sun dawned on the Day of Descension. The holiest day of the Nurity religion, it celebrated the first message received from God by Saint Dast and his thirty disciples.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As per tradition, the celebration w..."
entries.dialogueText: As per tradition, the celebration was held inside the Archsanctuary of Dastnurity, closed to the public eye.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "That was Lucian's idea. As he saw i..."
entries.dialogueText: That was Lucian's idea. As he saw it, granting the people a rare glimpse of the Grand Ceremony, and showing them how seriously their President took this holy event, would ease any tensions that lingered in the region.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And so we arrived at the largest ca..."
entries.dialogueText: And so we arrived at the largest cathedral in Sordland. A huge crowd gathered around our convoy as our car pulled up to the entrance.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“This will work out well. Trust me,..."
entries.dialogueText: “This will work out well. Trust me, sir.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Of course, that's only if the pray..."
entries.dialogueText: “Of course, that's only if the prayer is done completely correctly. Please don't forget the order.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“First, you will need to grasp the..."
entries.dialogueText: “First, you will need to grasp the holy sceptre with your left hand, then touch the altar with your right. Kneel before the Archpriest and wait for him to put the sword on your shoulder.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Pretty straightforward, isn't it?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Pretty straightforward, isn't it?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Yeah, sure.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Yeah, sure.”
entries.menuText: “Yeah, sure.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's just a ceremony. Whatever.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It's just a ceremony. Whatever.”
entries.menuText: “It's just a ceremony. Whatever.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I didn't understand a word you jus..."
entries.dialogueText: “I didn't understand a word you just said.”
entries.menuText: “I didn't understand a word you just said.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Just do your best to remember it...."
entries.dialogueText: “Just do your best to remember it. We can't afford to lose our religious base over this."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Very good.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very good.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“It's 'just' one of the most import..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's 'just' one of the most important ceremonies in Sordland. Especially for Deyr's Bludish residents.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“You will have to go first. I will..."
entries.dialogueText: “You will have to go first. I will come inside later and we will meet up after your part is done. Good luck, sir.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I exited the car and I was greeted..."
entries.dialogueText: I exited the car and I was greeted by a chorus of cheers and camera flashes. I waved to the people as I made my way to the grand gates.
entries.menuText: Exit the car.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Archsanctuary was a sight to se..."
entries.dialogueText: The Archsanctuary was a sight to see. With its towering visage, it cast a shadow over a large portion of the city. I had to crane my neck to see the narrow spires at the top. Just standing next to it made me feel awe and dread in equal measure.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I reached the gates, I spotted m..."
entries.dialogueText: As I reached the gates, I spotted my welcoming committee. The Archpriest and his disciples were waiting for my arrival. At my approach, they all bowed their heads in respect.

entries.speaker: Archpriest
entries.title: Archpriest: "“Mr. President. Praise God! It is a..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. Praise God! It is a blessing to see you on our most holy day again. Welcome, welcome.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He led me through the main hall, wh..."
entries.dialogueText: He led me through the main hall, which had a stratospheric ceiling and Nurist icons lining the walls. We walked up a creaking spiral staircase to the top floor and finally arrived in front of the confession chamber.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you. It is nice to be here i..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you. It is nice to be here in Deyr again.”
entries.menuText: “Thank you. It is nice to be here in Deyr again.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Archpriest.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Archpriest.”
entries.menuText: “Archpriest.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I bowed my head before the Archprie..."
entries.dialogueText: I bowed my head before the Archpriest, which triggered a few murmurs of approval from the crowd.
entries.menuText: Bow your head before the Archpriest.

entries.speaker: Archpriest
entries.title: Archpriest: "“Shall we move inside for your conf..."
entries.dialogueText: “Shall we move inside for your confession?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Sure. Let's get this over with.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Sure. Let's get this over with.”
entries.menuText: “Sure. Let's get this over with.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I pulled the Archpriest aside for a..."
entries.dialogueText: I pulled the Archpriest aside for a photo. Many flashbulbs burned my eyes at the same time. I heard whistles, claps and cheers from the crowd.
entries.menuText: Pull the Archpriest aside for a photo.

entries.speaker: Archpriest
entries.title: Archpriest: "“Most excellent.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Most excellent.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Archpriest gave me an infectiou..."
entries.dialogueText: The Archpriest gave me an infectious smile as he straightened back up. Tall and handsome, in his mid-50s, he was one of the youngest and most popular Archpriests in history. Some of his more avid followers even likened him to Saint Dast.

entries.speaker: Archpriest
entries.title: Archpriest: "“Oh, great people of Sordland! Once..."
entries.dialogueText: “Oh, great people of Sordland! Once again we are gathered here to honor the Day of Descension!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The crowd was still cheering loudly..."
entries.dialogueText: The crowd was still cheering loudly. The Archpriest turned and raised both of his hands, and everyone immediately fell silent.

entries.speaker: Archpriest
entries.title: Archpriest: "“I am indescribably happy to be sha..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am indescribably happy to be sharing this moment with you as well as every Blud and Sord, old and young, tuning in to their television to watch this holy commemoration!”

entries.speaker: Archpriest
entries.title: Archpriest: "“Along with the leader of our great..."
entries.dialogueText: “Along with the leader of our great nation, I say: Let the holy day begin!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smiled beatifically as the crowd..."
entries.dialogueText: He smiled beatifically as the crowd burst into rapturous applause. After it subsided, he turned to me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We made our way downstairs where th..."
entries.dialogueText: We made our way downstairs where the ceremony was already in progress. The choir sang angelically as the Archpriest took his position beside the altar. When they finished their hymn, an expectant silence fell over the room. It was time for my part.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I started my walk, bowed and approa..."
entries.dialogueText: I started my walk, bowed and approached the altar.
